import pandas as pd, requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re
url='https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-by-country/?region=worldwide&year=2023&metric=nominal'
html=requests.get(url,timeout=30).text
soup=BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
# find table
table=soup.find('table')
rows=[]
for tr in table.tbody.find_all('tr'):
    tds=[td.get_text(' ',strip=True) for td in tr.find_all('td')]
    if not tds: continue
    # columns: #, Country, GDP, GDP (full), Growth, Per capita, Share
    rows.append(tds)
print('cols',len(rows[0]),rows[0])
print('n',len(rows))
PY

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, requests, io
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
# worldometer share>=0.1 list
html=requests.get('https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-by-country/',timeout=30).text
soup=BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
table=soup.find_all('table')[1]
ths=[th.get_text(' ',strip=True) for th in table.thead.find_all('th')]
rows=[[td.get_text(' ',strip=True) for td in tr.find_all('td')] for tr in table.tbody.find_all('tr')]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=ths)
df['Share']=df['Share of World GDP'].str.replace('%','').astype(float)
share=df.loc[df['Share']>=0.1,['Country','Share']]
# load weo values
values_url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/imf-weo/main/data/values.csv'
cty_url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/imf-weo/main/data/country.csv'
values=pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(requests.get(values_url,timeout=60).text))
cty=pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(requests.get(cty_url,timeout=60).text))
# restrict indicator NGDP_RPCH years 2012-2020
v=values[(values.Indicator=='NGDP_RPCH') & (values.Year.between(2012,2020))]
# pivot
vp=v.pivot_table(index='Country',columns='Year',values='Value',aggfunc='first')
# map worldometer country name to ISO
name_to_iso={row.Name:row.ISO for row in cty.itertuples()}
# fix some name differences
fix={
'Russia':'Russian Federation',
'South Korea':'Korea',
'Vietnam':'Vietnam',
'Iran':'Iran',
'Czech Republic (Czechia)':'Czech Republic',
'United States':'United States',
'United Kingdom':'United Kingdom',
'Turkey':'Turkey',
'Taiwan':'Taiwan Province of China',
'Hong Kong':'Hong Kong SAR',
'Bolivia':'Bolivia',
'Venezuela':'Venezuela',
'Macao':'Macao SAR',
'Laos':'Lao P.D.R.',
'Brunei':'Brunei Darussalam',
'Syria':'Syrian Arab Republic',
'Yemen':'Yemen',
'North Macedonia':'North Macedonia',
'Cape Verde':'Cabo Verde'
}

# build country iso list for share>=0.1
isos=[]
missing=[]
for c in share.Country:
    nm=fix.get(c,c)
    iso=name_to_iso.get(nm)
    if not iso:
        # try direct match ignoring accents
        iso=None
    if iso: isos.append((c,iso))
    else: missing.append(c)
print('missing',missing)
# compute qualifying
qual=[]
for c,iso in isos:
    if iso not in vp.index: continue
    series=vp.loc[iso]
    if series.isna().any():
        continue
    if (series>1.5).all() and (series>=0).all():
        qual.append(c)
print('qual',qual)
PY
